content.title: First London Baptist Confession (1644; second edition 1646)
content.author: Seven Particular Baptist churches in London
content.note: The first Particular (Calvinistic) Baptist confession, which set out believer's baptism by immersion and the gathered church. For the beginnings of the Baptist confessional line; cite by article and name the edition (1644 or 1646), since they differ.
